div.p: ROSTER
OF
Company I, 24th Regiment
Massachusetts Volunteers

lg.l: E. B. Stillings & Co., 368 Congress Street

div.p: This Roster was prepared in accordance with a vote of the Association of the Survivors of Co. I, 24th Regt. Mass. Vols.
Boston, Jan. 20, 1902.
